findings.title: Production has no recoverable backup (30/30 daily backup runs failed ~1 month)
findings.evidence: gh run list --workflow=production-backup.yml => 30/30 failure 2026-06-12..2026-07-10; log: 'backup-production crashed: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL is required but not set'; SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY/CANONICAL_BRANCH_ID/BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY empty in run env.
findings.reproduction: gh run view <latest production-backup run id> --log-failed
findings.expected: Daily encrypted backup artifact + periodic restore drill.
findings.actual: Zero successful backups; script fails-closed on missing secrets; memory falsely records BACKUP_CERTIFIED.
findings.impact: Loss/corruption of the Supabase project is unrecoverable (orders, stock, compliance, traceability).
findings.root_cause: Required GitHub repo secrets never configured; red workflow unmonitored.
findings.containment: Take a manual encrypted supabase db dump + Storage export now, store off-platform.
findings.remediation: Set the 4 secrets; obtain one green run; schedule+execute documented restore drill; add backup-age<48h alert.
findings.regression_test: Monitor asserting latest successful backup run < 48h old.
findings.residual_risk: Free-tier Supabase has no PITR; RPO ~1 day.

findings.title: Production DB 3 migrations behind release; phase-3 truth-lock not applied => forgeable order-status/waste events and unaudited price edits in prod
findings.evidence: Prod get_applied_migration_versions head=202606300900 (35); repo=38. Missing 202606301000, 202607011300, 202607101200. Phase-3 comment: 'production predates the CLI explicit-grants default, so authenticated still HAS write grants there'; it REVOKEs INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE + drops permissive policies. /api/health reports 11/11 (expected_migrations lists only 11).
findings.reproduction: Compare prod applied versions to supabase/migrations/; read phase-3 migration.
findings.expected: Prod schema at head; direct client-role writes to audited tables blocked (as verify:truth-table-lock proves locally).
findings.actual: In prod any staff can INSERT order_status_events (forge state history); a manager can UPDATE products price (bypass price_changed audit) and INSERT inventory_waste_events without a ledger movement.
findings.impact: Falsified records, unaudited price changes, stock/waste evidence divergence.
findings.exploitability: Authenticated staff/manager session + direct PostgREST call (insider/compromised acct; not anon).
findings.root_cause: Deploys do not apply migrations to head; health check masks drift.
findings.containment: Apply the 3 missing migrations to prod (expand-safe: REVOKEs + policy drops only).
findings.remediation: Migrate-to-head on deploy; update expected_migrations to full security set; add deployed-vs-prod migration CI gate.
findings.regression_test: Integration test: authenticated cannot INSERT/UPDATE products/order_status_events/inventory_waste_events (exists locally; run vs prod parity).
findings.residual_risk: None once applied. Not live-write-confirmed on prod (would be an unauthorized write).

findings.title: Oversell shortfall recorded but raises no owner alert
findings.evidence: 0 functions reference both owner_alerts and shortfall; reconcile tray filters to cost-pending + waste-reason warnings only.
findings.expected: Oversell = visible anomaly with owner escalation (spec 26.3/26.9).
findings.actual: Shortfall stored in order_inventory_depletions + audit log only; not pushed to owner.
findings.impact: Owner may never see that goods left with the ledger short.
findings.remediation: On shortfall_kg>0 insert owner_alerts (warning) and surface in reconcile tray/TODAY.
findings.regression_test: Depletion with shortfall creates an unresolved owner_alert.

findings.title: Backup scope excludes Auth users, Storage objects and schema
findings.evidence: Backup is REST row-export of public tables; no auth.users, no Storage bucket/object export, no schema/functions/RLS.
findings.impact: Restore leaves profiles orphaned (no logins), evidence photos/certs lost, schema must be rebuilt.
findings.remediation: Add supabase db dump (schema+roles) + Storage sync + Auth reconstruction; validate each data class in the drill.

findings.title: next_order_ref anon-executable => unauthenticated order-sequence mutation
findings.evidence: has_function_privilege('anon',next_order_ref,'EXECUTE')=true. Live: anon POST /rest/v1/rpc/next_order_ref returned PTM-2026-00001/00002; last_sequence 0->2. Unthrottled.
findings.reproduction: curl -X POST <supabase>/rest/v1/rpc/next_order_ref with anon key + branch id.
findings.impact: Burn/advance order-ref numbers => sequential-numbering gaps + mild DoS. No money/stock/PII.
findings.remediation: REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION next_order_ref(uuid,date) FROM anon, PUBLIC (internal-only).

findings.title: Reversal idempotency per-reason not per-order => double-restore possible
findings.evidence: Idempotency = UNIQUE(order_id, source_event); source_event derives from reason. Two different reasons on one order restore SALE_COLLECT stock twice.
findings.impact: Inventory inflation if wired to UI. Mitigant: no src/ caller; requires authenticated+manager.
findings.remediation: Guard against any prior reversal group for the order's SALE_COLLECT before wiring reversal UI.

findings.title: Health migration-parity measured against 11 curated rows, masking real drift
findings.evidence: /api/health => migration_parity 11/11 HEALTHY while repo=38 and prod=35.
findings.impact: Owner dashboard reports green during real drift (enabler for PTM-REL-002).
findings.remediation: Base parity on full security-critical migration set or CLI ledger.

findings.title: CSP allows script-src 'unsafe-inline'
findings.impact: Weakens XSS defense. Rest of CSP strong.

findings.title: Metrics in-memory per serverless instance (unusable)
findings.evidence: /api/health metrics all 0 on warm prod instance; getMetricsSnapshot reads process memory.
findings.impact: Checkout/login/denied counters reset per cold start/instance; cannot detect failure rates.
findings.remediation: Emit to durable sink (Postgres counter table or metrics backend).

findings.title: No build identifier; deployed commit unverifiable
findings.evidence: No SHA in /api/health; no commit header; empty git metadata in env pull.
findings.impact: Production code cannot be reconciled to a commit (spec 40).
findings.remediation: Expose VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA via safe /api/health field or build constant.

findings.title: admin_create_inventory_batch has 3 coexisting overloads (schema drift)
findings.evidence: 3 signatures (13/14/16 args) present; old ones not dropped.
findings.impact: PostgREST overload ambiguity risk; maintenance confusion.

findings.title: Transitive postcss < 8.5.10 moderate CVE
findings.evidence: pnpm audit: 1 moderate, postcss@8.4.31 via next@15.5.18 (GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93).
findings.impact: Build-time CSS-stringify XSS; low practical risk.
findings.remediation: Bump via Next update / pnpm override.

findings.title: Repo hygiene: committed artifacts + stale branches + stale pilot tag
findings.evidence: Tracked dev-server.log, UI-screens zip, route-screenshots zip, pnpm.cmd; 13 stale branches; pilot-candidate-v1 tag 10 commits behind main.
findings.remediation: Gitignore/remove artifacts; prune merged branches; retag/delete stale pilot tag.

findings.title: order_notes INSERT checks branch, not order ownership
findings.evidence: WITH CHECK is_branch_staff(branch_id) validates note branch, not that order_id belongs to that branch.
findings.remediation: WITH CHECK should verify the order belongs to the actor's branch.

strong_positives: Server-side price recomputation; client price ignored (create_checkout_order).
FOR UPDATE pickup-window lock: no overbooking race.
FEFO depletion with consistent lock ordering; exactly-once via UNIQUE(order_id,source_event)+movement unique indexes.
Append-only inventory_movements enforced by trigger (no UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE for app roles).
Oversell floored at 0 (no negative stock), recorded + audited as visible anomaly.
RLS on all 48 tables; anon empirically gets [] on all sensitive tables; only storefront data public.
All 56 SECURITY DEFINER functions have pinned search_path; anon-executable admin RPCs hard-gate on auth.uid()+role.
create_checkout_order is service-role-only (customers cannot bypass the throttled server action).
No self-service role escalation (no profiles UPDATE policy for non-owners).
No EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS anywhere; fail-closed rate limiter and middleware.
Strong production security headers (HSTS preload, X-Frame-Options DENY, frame-ancestors none, nosniff).
IDOR-resistant public order boundary (unguessable access id; first-name-only DTO).
